svg.text: Datacenter-to-spoke traffic crosses the hub firewall
rt-sqlmi: 10.10.n.0/24 → afw-hub; SQL MI keeps service-managed routes
vm-dev01 → afw-hub → snet-pe: private backend tools
snet-servers → NAT Gateway → Internet: datacenter internet egress
snet-app → afw-hub → permitted public endpoints: controlled app egress
Peering is not transitive. Routes and Azure Firewall
n = assigned member index; repeat this network pair per member.
No direct datacenter-to-spoke peering, VPN, ExpressRoute or Virtual WAN.
